summary: Live mobile smoke testing covered app load, overview, queue search, applicant detail, and update request flows. Dashboard/search/stage/document/payment/duplicate APIs were reachable, but creating a new applicant returns HTTP 500 after insertion.

critical.issue: Returns 500 after inserting a valid applicant because the response contains MongoDB ObjectId; server log shows FastAPI jsonable_encoder failure.

minor.issue: No visible server-side cap prevents paid amount exceeding total_fee.
Document name is not validated against the checklist and can create arbitrary document keys.

integration_issues.issue: Valid create flow reports failure/does not complete because POST endpoint serializes ObjectId as 500.

action_items: Return the inserted applicant without MongoDB _id (or call clean(item) after insert) so POST /api/applicants returns 201/200 JSON.
Add payment bounds and document-name validation if those constraints are required by the admissions workflow.
Retest new application creation and queue persistence after the POST serialization fix.
critical_code_review_comments: POST create_applicant inserts item then returns it directly, unlike update endpoints that call clean(), causing the confirmed ObjectId serialization crash.
Frontend stage/document update handlers silently ignore non-2xx responses and provide no loading or error feedback.
seed_data_creation: A test applicant insertion was attempted by the UI; the database insert likely succeeded despite the 500 response. Existing seeded data was also mutated during stage/document smoke checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://mvp-to-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com. No auth is implemented. App loaded at 390x844. POST create failure is reproducible and logged in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. One detail-stage tap was blocked by the horizontal stage control being outside viewport in Playwright; use locator.scroll_into_view_if_needed() before tapping.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/applicants validates and inserts the payload, then returns the raw PyMongo insert document containing _id. FastAPI cannot encode ObjectId and emits 500. Mitigation: return clean(item), or explicitly exclude _id in the response. Verify duplicate protection still returns 409 and confirm created record appears in GET /api/applicants.
